rows.angle: Launch monopoly economics + Starlink (10.3M subs, $11.4B 2025 rev, but Q1 2026 ARPU down to $66 from $86); joined the Nasdaq-100 Jul 7, just 15 days post-IPO; now down ~47% from its post-IPO high, ~$1.58T mkt cap (~40x est. 2026 revenue)
rows.watch for: August/September lockup expirations; Starship cadence after a mid-July test flight abort (engine ignition failure); Starlink ARPU trend

rows.angle: Agreed to acquire Iridium for ~$8B cash+stock ($54/share — $27 cash plus RKLB stock, exchange ratio TBD; closing targeted mid-2027); selected for Golden Dome Space Based Interceptor program with Raytheon; closed Mynaric AG laser-comms acquisition
rows.watch for: Neutron debut (targeted Q4 2026 after a successful 5.5-min upper-stage engine test); Iridium deal financing/regulatory approval; stock drew fresh buying Jul 22 on an Air Force win plus the Iridium news

rows.angle: Awarded $955M by SDA (Jul 13) for 18 more Golden Dome Tranche 3 missile-tracking satellites, part of a $1.75B round (with Sierra Space) that brings total Tranche 3 to 104 spacecraft
rows.watch for: Further SDA/missile-tracking award flow; 2028 launch readiness

Space infrastructure components; among the hardest-hit names in July's pullback (~40% decline)

private_watchlist.name: Blue Origin
private_watchlist.note: New Glenn's 2nd flight deployed NASA's ESCAPADE spacecraft and landed its booster; a May 28 hotfire anomaly delayed the return-to-flight timeline, with recovery work still ongoing.

private_watchlist.name: Firefly Aerospace
private_watchlist.note: Record 2025 revenue of $159.9M (+163% YoY); landed a $75M NASA JPL subcontract for the "MoonFall" Moon Base mission; Blue Ghost Mission 2 targets a lunar far-side landing plus an ESA relay satellite deployment later in 2026.

private_watchlist.name: Stoke Space
private_watchlist.note: One of five firms (with SpaceX, ULA, Blue Origin, Rocket Lab) eligible for national-security launch missions; converting Cape Canaveral LC-14 for Nova's first flight, planned later in 2026; still named as a possible acquisition target amid AST SpaceMobile's capital raise.

bear_case.title: Capital intensity
bear_case.description: Rockets and constellations burn billions before returns; dilution is chronic among small caps.

bear_case.title: Government concentration
bear_case.description: Much of the sector's revenue is NASA/DoD; budget shifts reprice backlogs fast.

bear_case.title: SpaceX absorbs the value
bear_case.description: A dominant incumbent with launch-cost leverage can compress everyone else's margins — and SpaceX itself trades near 40x estimated 2026 revenue on a ~$1.58T market cap, with 2025 free cash flow of -$13.8B, Q1 2026 FCF of -$9.1B, and Starlink ARPU already sliding from $86 to $66.

bear_case.title: Binary mission risk
bear_case.description: One failed landing or launch can halve a small-cap (see lunar-lander names); SpaceX's own prospectus flags "key man" dependence on Elon Musk.

catalysts.title: Rocket Lab draws fresh buyers on Air Force win + Iridium news
catalysts.description: A U.S. Air Force contract win landed alongside continued follow-through on the Iridium acquisition, pulling traders back into RKLB after early-July weakness.

catalysts.title: SpaceX stock down ~23% since Nasdaq-100 inclusion; Starship test aborted
catalysts.description: A Starship test flight was scrubbed by an engine ignition failure, compounding a sell-off that has erased nearly a quarter of SPCX's value in ten days.

catalysts.title: SDA awards $1.75B for Golden Dome Tranche 3
catalysts.description: L3Harris ($955M/18 sats) and Sierra Space ($798M/18 sats) will build accelerated missile-tracking satellites for 2028 launch readiness, bringing the tranche total to 104 spacecraft.

catalysts.title: SpaceX joins the Nasdaq-100
catalysts.description: One of the fastest additions in index history — just 15 days after its June 12 IPO — triggering billions in passive index-fund flows.

catalysts.title: Broad space-stock pullback
catalysts.description: ASTS fell ~29% and LUNR/RDW sank ~40% in July's profit-taking wave after a torrid run; Viasat and Iridium were among the few names to close the month positive.

catalysts.title: Rocket Lab agrees to acquire Iridium (~$8B)
catalysts.description: Cash-and-stock deal at $54/share ($27 cash plus RKLB stock) hands Rocket Lab Iridium's global network and recurring cash flows; closing targeted mid-2027.
